description: Draft technical documentation or a Confluence page from the current project.

Use the `documentation-confluence` skill. Inspect relevant source, configuration, tests, and existing documentation. Draft a concise page for the requested audience. Ground each technical statement in the repository; separate assumptions and open questions. If Atlassian MCP is configured, search for related existing pages first. Do not publish, create, or update Confluence content until I review the full draft and explicitly approve the destination and action.
